name: @pipeworx/mcp-feodotracker

tools.name: list
tools.description: Current C&C blocklist (optional malware-family / status filter).

tools.name: check_ip
tools.description: Check whether a given IPv4 is on the current blocklist.

tools.name: recent
tools.description: Blocklist entries first seen in the last N hours.

tools.name: aggressive
tools.description: Full aggressive blocklist (includes older + lower-confidence IPs).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-feodotracker forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the feodotracker pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
